model.description: OpenAI model id (e.g. gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, o1). Left blank until live discovery selects the cheapest available model.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort level (model-specific). Common values: disabled, low, medium, high, xhigh

batchMode.description: Batch by target language or by entry

useStructuredOutput.description: Experimental — enabling this is experimental and may change. Request a valid-JSON response via OpenAI's native JSON mode (response_format json_object). Forces syntactically valid JSON so malformed output is far less likely. Off by default — enable only if you see 'malformed JSON from provider' errors.
